target.definition: lead converted to a paying customer of X Education

split_policy: stratified random 80/20 split with a fixed seed (the dataset has no time column)

lead_id.description: Lead Number from the CRM (primary key).

lead_origin.description: How the lead entered the CRM.

lead_source.description: Traffic source, normalised; rare sources = 'other', blank = 'unknown'.

do_not_email.description: 1 if the lead opted out of email.

total_visits.description: Site visits; missing values imputed with the median.

time_on_site_sec.description: Total time spent on the website, in seconds as exported by the CRM.

pages_per_visit.description: Average pages per visit; missing values imputed with the median.

specialization.description: Field of interest; the form default 'Select' and blanks = 'not_selected'.

free_copy_requested.description: 1 if the lead asked for the free 'Mastering The Interview' copy.

converted.description: 1 = became a paying customer, 0 = did not.

excluded_from_model.Tags: dropped at cleaning - LEAKAGE: written by the sales team after talking to the lead
excluded_from_model.Lead Quality: dropped at cleaning - LEAKAGE: sales rep's judgement after contact
excluded_from_model.Lead Profile: dropped at cleaning - LEAKAGE: assigned by sales after contact
excluded_from_model.Last Activity / Last Notable Activity: dropped at cleaning - LEAKAGE: includes post-contact events
excluded_from_model.Asymmetrique * (4 columns): dropped at cleaning - vendor scores computed after engagement, 46% missing
excluded_from_model.Country: dropped at cleaning - 27% missing and almost a single value
excluded_from_model.How did you hear / What matters most: dropped at cleaning - mostly blank or the form default 'Select'
excluded_from_model.Do Not Call, Search, Magazine, Newspaper: dropped at cleaning - constant or near constant

assumptions: One row per lead (Lead Number is unique).
time_on_site_sec is in seconds; the reference median is about 4 minutes. A median outside 100-700 means the unit changed.
The form default 'Select' means the lead did not choose a value; it is treated as 'not_selected', never as a category.
Columns filled in by the sales team after contact were dropped at cleaning (leakage) and must not come back as features.
There is no time column: the modeling crew must use a stratified random split with a fixed seed.
converted is known for every row; there are no open leads in this dataset, so no call list is produced from it.
